title: The Open Window
author: Saki (H. H. Munro)
edition: John Lane, The Bodley Head, 1914; printed pages 50–55
rights: Original literary text is public domain (1914 publication). The saved Wikisource revision is attributed as the transcription source; no audio or editorial annotations are used.

tragedy.text: Her great tragedy happened just three years ago

expected_return.text: my husband and brothers will be home directly from shooting

spaniel.text: A tired brown spaniel kept close at their heels.

figures.text: In the deepening twilight three figures were walking across the lawn towards the window

return_conversation.text: “Here we are, my dear,” said the bearer of the white mackintosh, coming in through the window

dogs.text: he told me he had a horror of dogs

closing_comment.text: Romance at short notice was her speciality.

private_doubt.text: Privately he doubted more than ever whether these formal visits on a succession of total strangers would do much towards helping the nerve cure which he was supposed to be undergoing.
